limits: Synthetic data; no human or Finder comparison
An underspecified task has a set of admissible objects, not one forced winner
Directory comparators know authorized immediate parent paths; direct-query comparators know a discriminative basename
Work reachability and selected representation usefulness are measured separately
Clarification is a scripted additional turn, not measured human effort
